meta.name: telegram-telethon
meta.description: This skill should be used for comprehensive Telegram automation via Telethon API. Use for sending/receiving messages, monitoring chats, running a background daemon that triggers Claude Code sessions, managing channels/groups, and downloading media. Triggers on "telegram daemon", "monitor telegram", "telegram bot", "spawn Claude from telegram", or any Telethon-related request. IMPORTANT: Use `draft` command for "драфт/draft", use `send` for "отправь/send"; if ambiguous, ASK before sending.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Telethon API 自动化 Telegram 消息收发与群组管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过代码自动化操作 Telegram 账号或频道。
copy.tagline_en: Automate Telegram messaging and group management via Telethon API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate Telegram account or channel operations programmatically.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Telethon API 发送/接收 Telegram 消息、监控聊天、管理频道/群组、下载媒体，并支持后台守护进程自动触发 Claude Code 会话。
howto.when: 当你说出“telegram daemon”、“monitor telegram”、“telegram bot”、“spawn Claude from telegram”等关键词，或提出任何与 Telethon 相关的请求时触发。

say.text: 发送消息给张三：明天下午3点开会
say.note: Claude 会使用 send 命令立即发送。

say.text: 为李四创建草稿：你好，最近怎么样？
say.note: Claude 会使用 draft 命令保存草稿，不发送。

say.text: 查看最近与王五的聊天记录
say.note: Claude 会调用 recent 命令获取最近消息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send/receive Telegram messages, monitor chats, manage channels/groups, download media via Telethon API, and run a background daemon that triggers Claude Code sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "telegram daemon", "monitor telegram", "telegram bot", "spawn Claude from telegram", or any Telethon-related request.

say_en.text: Send a message to John: meeting at 3pm tomorrow
say_en.note: Claude will use the send command immediately.

say_en.text: Create a draft for Jane: Hello, how are you?
say_en.note: Claude will use the draft command without sending.
Claude will call the recent command to fetch messages.
